label: estimate
notes: Checked-in retail estimate for the CosmaBot production VM foundation shape.
VM/ACR/storage envelope priced_on 2026-09-25; Azure OpenAI Data Zone token rates and OpenAI PE/DNS priced_on 2026-11-11 (Azure Retail Prices API eastus2).
Not an Azure invoice, reservation quote, or spending cap. No credits, tax, or transfer assumed.
Standing costs only in the printed totals. Token usage is pay-as-you-go and not included.

First-apply DataZoneStandard capacity is 1 (1000 TPM). Continuous-use ceiling at that capacity is 1000 TPM × 60 × 730 ≈ 43,800,000 tokens/month; dollar spend depends on input/output mix and is not a standing fee. Capacity increases only in the later LLM cutover ticket.

Reviewer arithmetic at saturation (capacity 1): about $96 to $385 a month of token spend depending on input/output mix at the Retail Prices rates above; not a standing fee and not included in the printed totals.
